about

I'm a web designer and brand strategist, sharpening my taste and learning to turn what a brand is really saying into something cohesive and memorable.

I came into design through music, fashion and culture. My music degree at Oxford taught me how much theory and thought sits behind art. My MA at King's then turned that interest into a fascination with what people wear, who people are, and how to really connect with them.

I start with research: who the audience is, who the competition is, and where the gap really sits. Then I write the brief and build the identity and website myself, in Adobe Illustrator and Claude Code. I've built an AI-native workflow, which you can see in my work with ZC Studios, and I push at the line between human creativity and AI automation. The aim isn't to take anything out of the making. It's to give me more time.
